name: c6_merge_hopstep
description: C1 followed by the merge. After the second capture is observed and the capture stopped, the harness opens the candidate and holds the apply button; the older record survives, the enhanced one is retired from disk and named in the survivor's merged_ids.json, and the pair is no longer a candidate. The survivor keeps the older id and date but the enhanced content, and normalisation drops both, so the record set equals the enhanced clip's single-clip golden.
